title: Pride Month with ChatOn
description: This Pride Month, ChatOn introduces Celebrate Pride, helping users explore what Pride really means and how to join in with heart and confidence. The Celebrate Pride collection isn't just a seasonal update—it's part of a broader mission to make technology more human. Because we believe progress starts with a question—and sometimes, that question may lead to a better world. Creating the best experience for our users earned us the Silver Lovie Award and the People's Lovie Award. This only proves that whether it's drafting emails, polishing resumes, planning trips, solving math issues, or beyond, ChatOn keeps things simple, quick, and stress-free.
